CHAPTER IV
CYBERSECURITY RISK-MANAGEMENT MEASURES AND REPORTING OBLIGATIONS
Article 20
Governance
1. 	Member States shall ensure that the management bodies of essential and important entities approve the cybersecurity
risk-management measures taken by those entities in order to comply with Article 21, oversee its implementation and can
be held liable for infringements by the entities of that Article.
The application of this paragraph shall be without prejudice to national law as regards the liability rules applicable to public
institutions, as well as the liability of public servants and elected or appointed officials.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Evidence (such as signed minutes or documented approvals) demonstrates management's approval and oversight of important IT security measures.

suggestedEvidence.text: Management meeting minutes with agenda items on IT security measure approval or oversight
Formal IT security policy approvals by management
Documented records of oversight reviews or reports

actual.sourceRecommendation: Assign clear responsibility for management to approve and oversee all important IT security measures. Document the oversight actions taken by management and maintain records of approvals. Once implementation is complete, ensure evidence—such as meeting minutes, policy approval records, or oversight reports—is available to verify compliance.
actual.objective: Ensure that management formally approves and actively oversees IT security measures with supporting documentation.

expected.sourceRecommendation: Establish and document a regular schedule for backup restoration testing. Maintain records of test outcomes and corrective actions. Ensure documentation is available for independent verification, such as test logs and backup recovery reports.
expected.objective: Document and perform regular backup restoration tests to ensure recoverability.

deliverables.text: Define a regular schedule for backup restore testing.
Conduct and document restore tests for all important data and systems.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Evidence (e.g., test protocols, recovery logs) is available to show regular and successful restore tests have been carried out.

suggestedEvidence.text: Backup test results and recovery logs
Scheduled test calendars
Incident reports from failed or partially successful restore attempts with follow-up actions
